# devin-backup

> Safe backup and restore for Devin Desktop stores: timestamped, SQLite-consistent snapshots of `sessions.db`, `acp-messages/`, `state.vscdb` and `.devin/` config, with integrity verification and retention rotation.

devin-backup solves two failure modes of naive file-copy backups of Devin's local stores: copying a live SQLite database can produce a corrupt snapshot (mid-write pages, unmerged WAL), and restoring an old backup over a newer install silently downgrades data across Devin's 17+ schema migrations. It snapshots through `sqlite3.Connection.backup()` (consistent even while Devin runs), records `schema_version` in every manifest via `devin-internals-spec`, verifies with `PRAGMA integrity_check` plus checksums, and warns "backup is v15, current is v17" on restore instead of a silent downgrade. It is for Devin CLI/Desktop users who want restorable, verifiable backups of their agent's local state. Fully local; restore is dry-run by default and every write is guarded by a pre-restore backup. Unofficial community tooling, not affiliated with Cognition AI.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/Icaro0310/devin-state/blob/main/packages/backup/README.md): full documentation
- [SPEC](https://github.com/Icaro0310/devin-state/blob/main/packages/backup/docs/SPEC.md): canonical spec (manifest format, exit codes)

## Key commands

- `pipx install "devin-backup @ git+https://github.com/Icaro0310/devin-state.git#subdirectory=packages/backup"`: install (Python >= 3.10)
- `devin-backup create [--data-dir DIR] [--config-dir DIR] [--out DIR]`: snapshot sessions.db, ACP message DBs, state.vscdb and .devin/ files
- `devin-backup preflight [--data-dir DIR] [--out DIR] [--json]`: per-check readiness report before `create`; exit 0 all-pass, 1 on FAIL/UNKNOWN, 2 usage error
- `devin-backup verify <snapshot-dir>`: re-check every hash + `PRAGMA integrity_check`; exit 1 on failure
- `devin-backup list [--out DIR]`: list snapshots
- `devin-backup restore <snapshot-dir> --to <data-root> [--apply]`: dry-run by default; `--apply` writes after a `pre-restore-<ts>` backup
- `devin-backup rotate [--keep N] --yes`: keep the newest N snapshots (default 10 or `$DEVIN_BACKUP_KEEP`); no-op until `--yes`

## When to use / when not

- Use when: you want point-in-time, restorable snapshots of Devin's local stores; you need copies that are consistent even while Devin is running; you want integrity verification (hashes + integrity_check) and schema-version warnings on restore; you want retention rotation so backups do not grow without bound.
- Not when: you need scheduled/automatic backups (M1 runs when you run it; Task Scheduler/cron integration is M2 — wrap the command yourself for now); you need encrypted or offsite/cloud backup (snapshots are plain copies to a folder you pick — put that folder on an encrypted volume or sync it yourself); you only care about session text, not restores (devin-history export may be enough).

- [devin-redact](https://github.com/Icaro0310/devin-state): recommended before running its `--apply` in-place redaction
- [devin-janitor](https://github.com/Icaro0310/devin-state): lifecycle cleanup; a backup first is the sane recipe
